name.description: The name of the package. Has to be globally unique.

author.description: The name of the author(s) of the package.

icon.description: The link of the package icon image file.

compatibleToVersion.description:
version up to what this package is compatible to; i.e. if another package can depend on this package by
version >= #compatibleToVersion then this package implementation promises to be compatible, i.e. execute all API
calls supported by that specific version.

@see Pkg.Category#COMPAT

dependencies.description:
The list of packages that this one depends on. Order of dependencies is significant if more then one package is
re-mixing the same type. I.e. in this case changing order of dependencies can change a resulting re-mixed type.

dbDomain.description: {@link Db.Domain} if this package's entity types belong to a specific Dd.Domain

testRunnerConfig.description: Default {@link TestRunnerConfig} used by {@TestRunner.testPackage} when no parameter is explicitly passed.

eslintConfig.description:
List of configurations to use for ESLint. Equivalent to contents of .eslintrc, but storing the config in the *.c3pkg.json is
preferred for persisting the config in {@link MetadataStore}

excludeImplicitDependencies.description:
When true, exclude implicit dependencies (e.g. genaiPlatform) during pkg wiring.
Platform is always included regardless of this flag.

Note: For implicit dependencies to be completely excluded from the dependency graph,
this flag must also be set to true on all transitive dependencies. If a dependency
does not have this flag set, it may still include implicit dependencies which will
then appear transitively in this package's dependency graph.

codeGen.description:
The kinds of code generation required by this package. Expected valid values are "Col", "Java", "Js", "Poly",
"Py", "React", "StdLib", "Type". A valid value must match precisely the prefix of an existing code generator class
name, of an error will be thrown.
